gen-righteous-gf-glegoo: Round, loud and a bit cheeky. Glegoo, a classic serif, keeps its tall lowercase and wide-mouthed curves easy to follow down a page, a refined editorial counterweight to Righteous.
gen-righteous-gf-hanuman: Righteous bends its rod-thin, marker-like line into fat, round letters that fill every bowl, while Hanuman sits beneath with a high-waisted lowercase. Text serif manners, quietly traditional.
gen-righteous-gf-kadwa: Righteous draws each letter with a single constant line and no thick-thin swing, round and a little playful. Kadwa follows as a text serif with open-ended curves and an oversized x-height.
gen-righteous-gf-noticia-text: Righteous lays down letters with no thick-thin modulation, its bowls filling the line like bent rod. Noticia Text answers as a literary text serif whose lowercase bodies take up most of the letter height.
gen-righteous-gf-piazzolla: Righteous bends its tails and terminals as thick as the main stems, with round bowls that fill the line out. Piazzolla, a text serif, is the authoritative foil.
gen-righteous-gf-pridi: Righteous looks like fine rope laid into round, commanding letters. Pridi, a serif with generous space between curve ends and stems, is where small letters stand proud and almost capital-sized, so one handles the shouting while the other handles the reading.
gen-righteous-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads as a traditional serif, its counters spilling into the space around them beside stubby ascenders and a big x-height. Righteous above it keeps o shapes equally thick all round.
gen-righteous-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is bookish and dignified, with large open counters in a, e and s that stay clear in rounded letters. Slabo 13px, a classic serif, would crowd if the heading were made small beside Righteous.
gen-righteous-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum reads dignified and editorial, its c as open as a bent paperclip and its x-height tall like a squared-off woodblock letter. Suwannaphum, a classic serif, carries a long page while Righteous bends stout diagonals and uprights into rounded fun.
gen-silkscreen-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Retro and lo-fi, Silkscreen leaves space around every letter that you can almost feel, like spaghetti laid out in type. BhuTuka Expanded One, a serif, slows reading to a leisurely walk with curvy letters.
